ratio_units: Growth, regression and reduction values are fractions: 0.30 means 30%.

supplemental_rss_maximum_review.method: Compare the maximum sampled per-run process peak in each scenario; preserve the frozen comparator median-based verdict separately.

paired_by_repetition_index.method: Run-number matching is a transparent diagnostic comparison, not a randomized paired experiment or control of allocator/OS history.

reviewed_disposition.criterion: SC-004 requires recording RSS and explaining/dispositioning increases above 10%; it does not impose an unconditional RSS ceiling.
reviewed_disposition.finding: Median growth is below 10% in every scenario. The maximum idle observation and seven run-number-matched peak comparisons exceed 10%; those observations are retained.
basis: The zero-worker path samples process RSS once, after semantic capture. It is not a continuously sampled idle peak.
One parent process performs all five repetitions; native/V8 allocation and garbage-collection history are not controlled.
The candidate sequence is nonmonotonic and later RSS declines; this bounds the observed trend but does not establish a cause or prove leak absence.
The observed increase is accepted for this fixed synthetic fixture benchmark, with explicit follow-up before broader production memory claims.

follow_up.scope: Fresh-process, allocator, native guard and teardown memory characterization, including longer idle observations, before broader production memory claims.

SC002.proof: all generation scanner counts in first pass only; zero positive-Qt TypeScript admissions

audit.phase_wall_and_thread_cpu_totals: All exclusive phase totals reconcile to their worker receipts; scanner work sums to generation receipts.

limitations: The preselected source is the fixed-Git synthetic 336-file representative fixture. These results are not FreeCAD-wide performance evidence.
OS filesystem cache and shared-host activity were uncontrolled. Five-run medians and ranges are reported without selecting the best arm or discarding failed repetitions.

Process CPU includes parent/controller, worker startup/teardown, V8/profiling and semantic capture in the documented measurement interval. Worker-thread intervals begin after profiler-loader imports and end before receipt cleanup.

Process CPU excludes CPU consumed by separate Git child processes. Git subprocess waits contribute to measured wall time where invoked inside the action; this is process CPU acceptance, not total system CPU accounting.
RSS is sampled process-wide at progress milestones and settlement, not an exact peak or isolated worker heap. Milestone RSS labels are not exclusive phase peak measurements.
Scanner counters omit parent validation/watcher/metadata/fingerprinting reads and do not count every operating-system syscall.
This compares the combined delivered changes. Individual optimization contributions and native-build effects are not separately attributed.

Source profiling supplies CPU acceptance. Separate compiled and installed MCP tests supply runtime convergence and native admission/termination evidence; these measurements are not labelled compiled CPU profiles.

Package closure, actual Windows portable execution and release/live installation remain separate T008 obligations. Provider-labelled test sessions do not prove actual Codex or Claude CLI plugin loading.
